gather.answer: Draft answer for 1.6.1, from the evidence found.

requirements.reason: No document defines what counts as a security event that staff must pass on.
No document sets out how staff pass on a security event.
No channel for talking with the people who raise an event is described.
No common point of contact for security events is named.
No channels by severity are described.
No document obliges staff to pass on events, and the training topics leave it out.
No channel for outside parties is described.
There is no information for staff on how to pass on an event.
No feedback to the people who raise an event is described.
